articles.summary: MORRISVILLE, Vt., April 15, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Union Bankshares, Inc. (NASDAQ - UNB) today announced results for the three months ended March 31, 2026 and declared a regular quarterly cash dividend. Consolidated net income for the three months ended March 31, 2026 was $3.0 million, or $0.65 per share, compared to $2.5 million, or $0.55 per share, for the same period in 2025.
